title: Other Important Commissions
definition: Ad-hoc or statutory bodies constituted by the British colonial administration to investigate, report, or reform specific socio-economic, political, or administrative issues in India.
importanceInUpsc: These commissions are frequently tested in Prelims (matching commissions with their objectives/years) and provide critical context for Mains answers on colonial administrative evolution.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Other Important Commissions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
